user.title: Add an animal
user.description: Each SOAP Opera entry tracks one animal. Add another entry to track a second animal.

error.name_exists: An animal with this name is already configured.

user.title: Medication
user.description: Choose the medication this regimen is for, or define a new one.

medication.title: New medication
medication.description: Tablets, capsules and patches need a strength per unit. Liquids need a concentration per mL instead.

data.unit_strength: Strength per tablet / capsule / patch, or per mL for a liquid
data.dose_increment: Dose increment (in the same units as the standard dose)
data.dose_max_single: Maximum single dose (in the medication's unit, e.g. mg)
data.dose_max_daily: Maximum total per 24 hours (in the medication's unit)
data.end_date: End date (optional, for a fixed course)

reconfigure.title: Edit regimen for {medication}
reconfigure.description: Changing the dose, strength, timing, interval, or variable-dose limits records a new version of this regimen. It starts on the effective date, and the current version (in force since {current_since}) ends that day. Changing only the indication, the prescribing vet, or the end date corrects the current version, and the effective date is ignored.

data.unit_strength: Strength per tablet / capsule / patch, or per mL for a liquid
data.dose_increment: Dose increment (in the same units as the standard dose)
data.dose_max_single: Maximum single dose (in the medication's unit, e.g. mg)
data.dose_max_daily: Maximum total per 24 hours (in the medication's unit)
data.end_date: End date (optional, for a fixed course)
data.effective_date: Effective date of a dosing change

error.increment_required: A variable dose needs an increment.
error.end_before_start: The end date must be after the start date.
error.effective_before_current: A dosing change can't take effect before the current version started.
error.effective_after_end: A dosing change must take effect before the regimen's end date.
error.overlap: This animal already has a regimen for this medication during those dates.
error.strength_required: A tablet, capsule or patch needs a strength.

abort.not_loaded: This animal's entry must be loaded before regimens can be added.
